label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, late in episode, when choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (95% of mass has prev_reward=0; never when the reward input is 1), and only late in the episode (essentially zero before trial 45, peaks in trials 60-89). Within that it is strongly biased to GO steps where the agent picks a2 (model_act=2 / choice logit strongly negative, 92% of mass), and to lower value-head outputs (5.2-7.5). Strongest activations: a2 picks following unrewarded a2 trials. GO & prev_reward=0 & ep_trial>=50 alone gives recall 0.89 / mass recall 0.95 but precision 0.46; adding the agent own upcoming choice (a2) raises precision to about 0.75 (dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.88). The predicate uses only observed inputs and the agent own policy at that step, no future outcomes. Misses are weak activations on a1 picks or rewarded-previous trials; false positives are qualifying a2 GO steps with no activation, so the late-episode dependence is graded rather than a sharp threshold.
